title: Mixing & mastering
intro: Send me your track and I'll bring it to life: clear lows, open space, and a master that sounds right on a festival system, in headphones and on streaming. I work especially with organic, downtempo, ecstatic dance and world electronica, music with field recordings and live instruments.

services.name: Mastering
services.details: Stereo master ready for streaming, 24-bit WAV + MP3, 2 revisions

services.name: Stem mastering
services.details: Mastered from up to 8 stems (drums, bass, pads, vocals…) for more control, 2 revisions

services.name: Mixing
services.details: Full mix from your stems, up to 40 tracks, 2 revisions

services.name: Mix + master
services.details: Both together, one smooth process, 2 revisions on each

packages_note: EPs and albums: 10% off when you book 4 tracks or more, mastered to flow together as one release.
turnaround: Usually ready in 3 to 5 working days.
